definitions.explanation: The state of two or more things being consistent and free of contradiction, or the act of making them agree. Common in technical, logical, and administrative contexts such as data, theories, and rules.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{整合|せいごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{整合|せいごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: to bring the two systems into alignment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{既存|きそん}→既存：27736_kison⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{整合|せいごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to check whether the new rule is consistent with existing laws.

notes:
Combines {整|せい} (arrange, order) + ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ (match, fit). The condition of things fitting together without contradiction, or the act of making them do so. Frequent in technical and administrative writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整合|せいごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to make things consistent
- {整合|せいごう}{性|せい}: consistency (as a property)
- {整合|せいごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to seek alignment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧: agreement; match — emphasizes things being identical or in accord
- ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧: contradiction — the opposite state, where things conflict
